question: Create a rest-policy draft for November 1-3, 2026 with people P1 and P2 and shift types D, D+, N and N+. D+ and N+ are the senior variants of day and night. Do not add staffing counts, eligibility restrictions, work-streak limits, fairness or primary-shift rules. Keep the required one-shift-per-day rule. Do not optimize.
